end.summary:
Practised “unity in diversity” and “many in the one.”
Used an orchestra analogy for different parts contributing to one tune.
Gave examples of regional festivals, foods, clothing and languages.
The connection between differences and unity remained unclear at the end.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining unity in diversity and gave examples such as Makar Sankranti, Pongal, Lohri, phiran and regional languages. The orchestra analogy helped show how different parts can contribute to one whole. They mixed up “being different” with “being united”; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask Riya to name two different festivals and one shared purpose or value they have.
